raw.query: WITH selected AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_span_s, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.experiment = 'factorial' AND d.policy = 'forecast' AND d.forecast_model = 'chronos' AND d.quantile = 'p90' AND d.lead_s = 30 AND d.cold_start_s = 30 AND d.rho = 15 AND d.actuation = 'issue-time' AND d.run_id LIKE '%:warm:%'), checked AS (SELECT s.*, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.denominator_kind, c.cost_ratio, c.denominator_window_mismatch FROM selected s LEFT JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio c ON c.run_id = s.run_id AND c.is_current = true AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8') SELECT COUNT(*) AS selected_rows, COUNT(cost_ratio) AS backed_cost_rows, MAX(window_span_s) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'aggregate') AS aggregate_span_s, MAX(window_span_s) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'aggregate') / 86400.0 AS aggregate_span_days, MAX(cost_ratio) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'aggregate') AS aggregate_cost_ratio, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('window', window_name, 'span_s', window_span_s, 'run_id', run_id, 'is_current', is_current, 'superseded_by', superseded_by, 'numerator_worker_seconds', numerator_worker_seconds, 'denominator_worker_seconds', denominator_worker_seconds, 'denominator_workers', denominator_workers, 'denominator_kind', denominator_kind, 'cost_ratio', cost_ratio, 'denominator_window_mismatch', denominator_window_mismatch) ORDER BY CASE WHEN window_name = 'aggregate' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, window_name) AS per_window_breakdown FROM checked
